speakers.description: A knight in battered plate armour.

description.text: Far below, a burning battlefield stretches beneath a ceiling of smoke, its collapsed trenches and shattered barricades glowing in rivers of orange fire. A huge black dragon sweeps low through the ash, wings spread wide as embers stream past its horns and scarred scales. A knight in battered plate armour rides braced behind the dragon's neck, one gauntleted hand locked on the saddle chain, the other pressed against the beast's warm hide. Wind flattens the smoke into long ribbons; firelight catches the dents and scratches in the knight's armour and the dragon's glossy black plates. The dragon descends toward the smoke layer, revealing more of the ruined field below while burning wreckage throws sparks upward.
Heavy wingbeats and rushing wind dominate as fire crackles far below.
Embers and smoke stream past the dragon's wings as it skims above collapsed trenches.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

The knight braces behind the dragon's neck, visor turned toward the battlefield below. The rider shifts up from a low riding crouch, raises a gauntleted fist, and shouts a command into the rushing wind; the visor snaps with the force of the words, embers striking the metal and spinning away. The dragon's neck flexes under the knight's legs, its black scales shifting as it holds a steady line through the smoke. Below, trenches burn in broken lines, and the fire glow climbs across the knight's battered plate, picking out every scrape and rivet. The knight keeps the fist raised for a beat, then grips the saddle again as the wind buffets the pair.
The knight rises from the riding crouch and raises a gauntleted fist toward the burning field.
Armour plates clatter and wind buffets the riders as fire crackles below.
The knight's shout cuts briefly through the rushing air, then fades under the wind.
The camera holds a static shot.

The dragon banks hard over a wall of flame, one wingtip cutting through a plume of sparks. Firelight washes across its black scales and the knight's battered plate as the beast climbs through billowing smoke, leaving the burning trench line behind. The knight clings to the saddle with both hands, body low, boots braced against the dragon's ridged back. The dragon's jaws open in a roar that rattles the air; its wings beat once, twice, driving the pair upward. Below, the battlefield opens into a wider view of fire, collapsed earth, and drifting ash, while smoke tears past the dragon's horns and the knight's helm.
A dragon roar rolls across the battlefield, followed by a fire whoosh and rattling armour.
The dragon climbs through billowing smoke as the knight braces low against its back.
The camera arcs around the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

soundscape: Heavy wingbeats, rushing wind, crackling fire, distant fire roar, and occasional armour clatter.
